instruction: Create a symbolic link named 'link1' that points to 'file1'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: if [ -L link1 ] && [ "$(readlink link1)" = "file1" ]; then echo 'Success: symbolic link link1 points to file1.'; else echo 'Failure: symbolic link not created correctly.'; fi

include: Success: symbolic link link1 points to file1.
